role: Opt-in (-mastra-r5900-extern-buffer): buffer the assembly body and emit .extern name,size in front of it for GP-eligible externals that actually reach assembly as a bare integer memory reference, so the single-pass GAS can choose the retail gp-relative form. HIGH/LO_SUM references and FP accesses are never marked; TARGET_FILE_SWITCHING stays at its original definition.
mechanism: mips.c: extern_list gains r5900_bare_int_ref; mips_asm_file_start redirects output to a tmpfile when the flag is set; print_operand's MEM case marks bare SYMBOL_REF integer references whose SYMBOL_REF_FLAG is set; mips_asm_file_end emits the marked .extern declarations to the real stream, then copies the buffered body and restores the stream state.
default_neutrality: Flag off: wide sweep byte-identical (272 exact, zero diffs) - verified.
